features.name: Hub
features.description: External cylindrical hub section with a tapered end chamfer.

features.name: Step Face

component_specs.extraction_notes: Some symbols such as α were extracted from the character 'a' in the symbol column based on standard gear nomenclature. Also, the symbol 'd_b' was interpreted as 'db' due to rendering.

component_spec_links.link_notes: Spec describes the external spur gear; these features depict the gear tooth zone (front face and axial section/OD boundary).

assumptions.text: front_view:F1 and section_aa:F1 represent the same physical central feature set (through bore with additional flat-controlled width), grouped with section_aa:F1 as canonical due to full diameter, chamfers, and datum definition.

front_view:F2, section_aa:F3, and detail_z:F1 refer to the same hub/shoulder zone; detail Z is an enlargement providing undercut geometry for that zone. Canonical set to section_aa:F3 which carries primary OD and length data.
front_view:F3 and section_aa:F2 are the same external gear OD/teeth boundary; section_aa:F2 chosen as canonical because it contains the full diametral and width dimensions and GD&T.
Unattached callout UC1 (22,7 ±0,1) is interpreted as the overall axial length but its exact faces are unclear; dropped from auto-assignment pending customer confirmation (Clarification C01).
Primary machining axis is the bore axis (+Z) per view notes; datum origin taken as datum A (bore axis).
Set the 22,7 ±0,1 dimension as the overall part length between the two extreme axial faces, excluding chamfers.
Set the 0,08 GD&T frames on the gear OD and hub OD as circular runout relative to datum A.
